title: 第008章 除了她不考虑其他人
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这家会员制俱乐部是前两年新开的，档次和配置堪称顶级。

舒楹来之前问过余露，据说俱乐部股东都是江城有头有脸的人物。就算为了攀附这些人，来办会员的人也不会少。

谢家多半是有参股的，但哪怕没有，老板也乐意卖谢亭渝一个面子。

眼下长发男屁滚尿流地被保安请走，场地瞬间安静下来，谁都不想轻易得罪了谢家。

听话锋谢亭渝身后跟着的就是俱乐部的高管，长发男被除名，以后基本就告别江城的大场面活动了。

程昱摸了摸鼻子，率先上前跟谢亭渝寒暄，“对不住，我没想到他这么口无遮拦。”

“你喊来的？”谢亭渝直直看他一眼。

“对，准备做个项目，拉了几个感兴趣的一块儿来聊聊。”程昱本意是想重点介绍舒楹，谁知道会闹成这样。事儿不算大，只是偏偏惹了谢亭渝。

“什么项目？”

程昱没预料他会多嘴一问，下意识看向舒楹，“我能做什么项目？就一不入流的短剧。”

“你在娱乐圈可没少赚。”谢亭渝不置可否。

程昱摸不准他的意思，“你感兴趣的话我发你资料？”

“在这聊？还骑马吗？”

后面这句话像是问的舒楹，程昱估计她不会有心情玩乐，“去茶馆吧。”

“行。”谢亭渝转身跟那两个高管交代一声，带着助理和程昱对了个眼神。

程昱忙不迭拉着舒楹跟上。

他和谢亭渝算是远亲，关系不远不近的，唯一特别的是三年前他偶然撞见过谢亭渝和舒楹。

顶贵谢家的唯一继承人，穿百来块的平价衣服，牵着一个漂亮女人的手在商场闲逛，和路边的大多数情侣没有分别。

怪的是那是一家开在偏远地带的普通商场，跟高奢谈不上半毛钱关系，更没有投资价值。

当时程昱以为自己眼花了，他诧异地叫住谢亭渝，那两道身影齐齐回头。

别的不说，外形是真的般配。

以至于时隔多年回想起这一幕，他依然觉得惊艳。

茶馆开在竹林里，暮春时节不太需要调节温度，仿古的窗子往外看着，风吹竹林响起的簌簌声很悦耳。

Page (1/3)

This membership-only club was newly opened in the past two years, and its quality and configuration are top-notch.

Shu Ying asked Yu Lu before coming. It is said that the club's shareholders are all prominent figures in Jiangcheng.Even for the sake of clinging to these people, there will be many people who come to apply for membership.

Most of the Xie family has shares, but even if they don't, the boss is willing to sell Xie Tingyu to save face.

At this moment, the long-haired man was peeing and being asked to leave by the security guards. The venue instantly became quiet. No one wanted to offend the Xie family easily.

After listening to the talker Xie Tingyu, he was followed by the club's executives. The long-haired man was removed from the team and basically said goodbye to Jiangcheng's big events from now on.

Cheng Yu touched his nose and took the lead to greet Xie Tingyu, "I'm sorry, I didn't expect him to be so open-minded."

"Did you call me here?" Xie Tingyu looked at him directly.

"Yes, I'm going to work on a project. I've gathered a few interested people to talk about it." Cheng Yu's original intention was to introduce Shu Ying, but who knew it would end up like this.The matter was not serious, but Xie Tingyu was offended.

"What project?"

Cheng Yu didn't expect him to ask more questions, and subconsciously looked at Shu Ying, "What kind of project can I do? Just a short play that's not popular."

"You make a lot of money in the entertainment industry." Xie Tingyu was noncommittal.

Cheng Yu wasn't sure what he meant, "If you're interested, I'll send you the information?"

"Are you talking here? Are you still riding a horse?"

The latter sentence seemed to be a question to Shu Ying. Cheng Yu estimated that she was not in the mood to have fun, "Let's go to the teahouse."

"Okay." Xie Tingyu turned around and told the two executives, and looked at Cheng Yu with his assistant.

Cheng Yu hurriedly pulled Shu Ying to follow him.

He and Xie Tingyu were distant relatives, neither far nor close. The only special thing was that he bumped into Xie Tingyu and Shu Ying three years ago.

The sole heir of the most expensive Xie family, wearing cheap clothes worth more than a hundred yuan, holding the hand of a beautiful woman and strolling around the mall, he was no different from most couples on the roadside.

The strange thing is that it is an ordinary shopping mall opened in a remote area. It has nothing to do with high luxury, and it has no investment value.

At that time, Cheng Yu thought he was dazzled. He stopped Xie Tingyu in surprise, and the two figures turned back.

Apart from anything else, the appearance really matches.

So much so that when he recalled this scene after many years, he still felt amazed.

The teahouse is located in a bamboo forest. There is no need to adjust the temperature in late spring. Looking out from the antique window, the rustling sound of the bamboo forest in the wind is very pleasant.
